articleTitle: A LDA model based text-mining method to recommend reviewer for proposal of research project selection
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Reviewer recommendation for research projects proposals plays an indispensable role in funding agencies, because the opinions or feedback of reviewers will exert a direct impact on the result of the projects selection. Current methods mainly focus on grouping the proposals by declared disciplines or evaluating the reviewers with their individual profile, however, the two methods ignore the rich information with different types and formats of proposals and experts, such as subjective information (e.g., evaluation of colleague), objective information (e.g., publications' number). Besides, prior studies mostly applied to English documents, which has limitations when dealing with projects proposals in Chinese. In order to effectively solve the research gap that ignored the different information forms and Chinese contexts, this paper proposes firstly extract the topics words in proposal by LDA and expert's profile with text-mining; secondly automatically classify the information of proposal and profile, and integrate the information into several categories according to its different types. Each category represents the different dimensions of information of proposal and expert. Thirdly, we calculate the similarity of information in each category, and sort the similarity to select top 8 experts as candidate reviewers. Finally, we establish the evaluation model for the candidate reviewers to decide several reviewers to review proposal. A recommendation approach is proposed by integrating these categories of information. In future research, we will try to evaluate the proposed approach using real data.

articleTitle: E-commerce customer churn prediction based on improved SMOTE and AdaBoost
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: E-commerce customer churn rate is high and the customer churn dataset is seriously imbalanced. In order to improve the prediction accuracy of churn customers as well as strengthen to identify non-churn customers, this paper presents e-commerce customer churn prediction model based on improved SMOTE and AdaBoost. First, processing the churn data with improved SMOTE, which combines oversampling and undersampling methods to address the imbalance problem and subsequently integrates AdaBoost algorithm to predict. Finally, the empirical study on B2C E-commerce platform proves that this model has better efficiency and accuracy compared with the mature customer churn prediction algorithms.

articleTitle: Mapping smart tourism research in China: A semantic and social network analysis using CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Understanding how domain knowledge grows and evolves over time is critical to innovation in science and technology. In this study, a knowledge domain of smart tourism research in China is visually mapped through CiteSpace by a combination of semantic network analysis of research subjects and social network analysis of collaboration research network. Smart tourism related literature was collected from the leading scientific literature database CNKI in China. The results reveal the thematic patterns and emerging trends in research of smart tourism in China. The results also identify the influential smart tourism research institutes and scholars in China. The combination of semantic and social network analysis can provide a complete innovation landscape of an emerging field of science. Practical and theoretical implications are also discussed.

articleTitle: A short literature review on reward-based crowdfunding
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In this short article, we discuss about a popular online fundraising method, named crowdfunding. One of the most useful types is reward-based crowdfunding, where the return is tangible products. We review related researches from three streams, the conceptual research, the empirical research, and the modelling research. Some possible research directions are also discussed in the paper.

articleTitle: An empirical study of crowdfunding campaigns: Evidence from Jing Dong crowdfunding platform
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: By forming a dataset of 1557 technology projects from Jing Dong crowdfunding platform with over 1.1 billion RMB pledges in total, this paper provides in-depth analysis on the determinants leading to highly successful crowdfunding. The results suggest that the goal and backers are positively associated with promising outcomes, and having a video makes a difference for achieving more funding while images and updates don't. Likes are also related to successful fundraising. Moreover, backing experience of founders does harm to crowdfunding efforts, and less first level pledge of price menu means more funding while high second level pledge makes raising large amount of money possible.

articleTitle: An ARIMA based model for forecasting the patient number of epidemic disease
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Forecasting the number of epidemic disease is very important for CDC (center for disease control and prevention). To improve the forecast accuracy, an ARIMA (autoregressive integrated moving average) based model is proposed in this paper. First, autocorrelation (AC) and partial autocorrelation (PAC) analysis are introduced to establish a stationary time series, where the autocorrelation order, moving average order and difference order are estimated. Secondly, least square s method (LS) is employed to estimate the parameters of the prediction model. Finally, the real data between Jan. and Aug. 2014 coming from a CDC are fed into the proposed model and the forecast accuracy obtained is 92.1%, which significantly outperforms the simple moving average method currently used in the CDC.

articleTitle: Research on construction of takeout O2O platform service quality evaluation system
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper analyzes the characteristics of the takeout restaurant and takeout website, and constructs the service quality evaluation system of the O2O takeout platform based on the SERVPERF model and the ETAILQ model. The paper also uses the data collected by the questionnaires to carry out exploratory factor analysis. The results show that the takeout O2O platform service quality evaluation index system includes two main aspects of the website service quality evaluation and the restaurant service quality evaluation. Takeout restaurant service quality evaluation contains three dimensions of empathy, timeliness, reliability. Takeout website service quality evaluation contains two dimensions of security and website design.

articleTitle: Chain-to-chain competition under the cap-and-trade scheme
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper considers two competing supply chains under the cap and trade scheme, each of which consists of one manufacturer and one retailer. In the vertical direction, the manufacturer is the leader of Stackelberg game; in the horizontal direction, there is a parallel competition about the product greening level between manufacturers. We solve and analyze the equilibrium solutions of a centralized supply chain (CSC) and a decentralized supply chain (DSC) respectively. The results show that the greening level of CSC is higher than that of DSC, and the corresponding price is lower than that of DSC. That means the CSC has greater competitive advantage. Numerical analysis reveals that higher emissions reduction investment coefficient leads to lower greening level and higher retail price; higher greening level competition degree leads to lower greening level, whereas affects retail price differently in CSC and DSC.

articleTitle: A systematic fuzzy QFD model and its application to hotel service design
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: It is important for hotel industry to provide high quality service so as to increase customer satisfaction. The hotel industry traditionally tries to investigate customer satisfaction via the guest comment card. Unfortunately, it lacks a method to convert the collected massages to applicable suggestions. Quality function deployment (QFD) is a customer-oriented product and service design method. The aim of this study is to provide a QFD-based service improvement model for the hotel industry. Accordingly, we have proposed a nine-step house of quality model, which combines fuzzy logic in the human language judgments and entropy method to assess customer need competitive priority. Finally, a case study is presented to examine the validity of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Design of dynamic vehicle routing system based on online map service
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Most vehicle routing systems use local map data, and can only handle static customer demand and transportation information. This paper presents a solution to develop dynamic vehicle routing system based on online map service. Google maps API is adopted to construct map related functions like route display, address geocoding, distance matrix and so on. A Variable Neighborhood Search algorithm is designed to calculate the dynamic vehicle routing problem. Strategies in response to real-time customer demand and real-time traffic information are introduced to dynamically adjust vehicle routes. A real-world application has proven that this technology can improve the efficiency of transport decision and save logistics cost to a large extent.

articleTitle: The impact of website quality on user loyalty through perceived value and commitment
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Web-user loyalty or website stickiness is quite important for website owners, whatever product or service they provide. Just like traditional store environment atmosphere, website quality will have great influence on users' psychological perception, and then further affect their attitude or behavior. Based on the literature related to the relationship between website quality and users` behavior or attitude, we adopt the technology acceptance model (TAM) and stimulus-organism-response(S-O-R) theory to build a conceptual model, studying how the website quality influence user loyalty through users' perceived value and commitment; besides, we explore whether website quality will have different effect on user loyalty faced with different website types by conducting an empirical research.

articleTitle: Applying Kansei Engineering to service design: A case study of budget hotel service
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Due to the rising competition in budget hotel sector, it becomes more and more imperative for service providers to increase their competitiveness. Nowadays, customers have put more attention to satisfy their feelings. Therefore, service designers need to investigate customers' real feelings and improve their services to meet customers' needs. In this paper, the Kansei Engineering (KE), a tool for translating people's feelings and emotions into product or service elements, is adopted for the budget hotels services. Moreover, in the experiment part, the associations between Kansei and customers' overall satisfactions are also taken into account. By this, we focus on the relationships between the service attributes and Kansei, and the ones between Kansei and customers' overall satisfactions. Among these, the Partial Least Squares (PLS) regression method is utilized to analyze these relationships. Finally, we have achieved a meaningful result and demonstrated that KE performs well on solving the budget hotel service problem.

articleTitle: A study on the equity of health resources and equalization development in Yunnan Province from 2009 to 2013
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Appropriate heath resource allocation is the primary condition for protecting all society members to obtain effective and equity health service, and meanwhile, it is the main approach to reduce the health discrepancies among residents in Yunnan Province. This paper collects the medical resource data of 16 cities and prefectures in Yunnan from 2009–2013. This paper measures the discrepancies of medical service among different areas by using Theil Index Analysis, and finds that the total difference of basic health service among east, middle, west and south areas decrease gradually. However, the equity of health institutions and hospital beds is significantly better than health workers. Through Theil Index composition analysis, we find that in aspects of health institutes and health workers, the key element for the inequality of health institutions is the imbalance within middle area, however, for the hospital beds inequity, the main factor is the inequality between areas. Therefore, to facilitate the equity of medical resources, it is necessary to have clear development strategy, optimize the structure of health input, set reasonable layout of health institutions, strengthen the health infrastructure, and improve the quality of health workers.

articleTitle: Optimization of double-deep rack's dual command cycles based on big data
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the increasing of the land cost, people want to improve the utilization of space and reduce the cost. Applying double-deep rack in automatic storage and combining two rows of goods racks to reduce aisles and increase the density of storage location. At the same time, in order to meet and response rapidly to the personalized requirements of customers, double-deep rack can store multiple varieties and small batch of goods. Cranes that use dual command cycles in warehousing system can improve the efficiency of automatic storage. In order to work out a problem about storage optimization of double-deep rack. First, a time model of dual command cycles is established, which takes the time that the crane runs to storage location and the storage and retrieval products into consideration. Then, the optimization algorithm is proposed and tested correctly by an example. Finally, it can be applied in practical industry widely.

articleTitle: The optimized selection methods of marine search and rescue ships
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In maritime search and rescue, selecting the appropriate ships to operate search and rescue, are very important in life rescue and property salvage. According to the modern decision theory and fuzzy mathematics evaluation method on the different factors of ships (the professional degree, and the response time, etc.), this paper applies three kinds of multi-objective optimized selection method of maritime search and rescue ships. The first uses multi-attributte weighted decision and evaluation method, in which the attribute weights are scored via the expert method. The second employs the Hamming distance combined the negative exponential satisfaction degree curves with importance degree comprehensive evaluation method, in which the attribute weights are computed by the negative exponential satisfaction degree distribution curves. The third is the fuzzy similar priority ratio evaluation method, consisting of corresponding mathematical models, the application of priority ration evaluation, and the comprehensive ranking and the weight ranking method. Besides, this paper has put forward several measures to improve the three methods, which make these methods more objective and reasonable. On this basis, compared with the results of the three methods, it proves that in the maritime search and rescue, the three methods are feasible, and the time factor is the most important factor to decide the ship selection.

articleTitle: An empirical study on inline impact factors of reviews usefulness based on movie reviews
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The purpose of the present study was address the research question, what factors make online reviews useful? To answer this question, we collected online reviews for movies from a popular user generated movie review platform, douban.com. Using data mining technology, this paper constructs an online impact factors reviews model. The results demonstrate that review characteristics indeed influence users' perceptions of reviews' usefulness. Specifically, online reviews' length, positive attitude, extreme emotional tendency and the timeliness of the review have significantly positive impacts on reviews usefulness. Furthermore, the positive emotion is more helpful and can even be more persuasive than the negative emotion. Results also suggest review quantity moderates the relationship between online reviews extreme emotional tendency and reviews usefulness. The study sheds light on how users' evaluate online reviews, and our findings can also help practitioners as they develop tools to leverage reviews to predict product's market success.

articleTitle: The impact of atmospherics in virtual community on online impulse buying intention: The moderating effect of product types
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the rapid development of technology, Internet has changed people's lives and online community has become a comprehensive platform for exchanging ideas and shopping. This study develops and tests an environmental psychology model of online impulse purchase. The model captures the moderating effect of search and experience product type on the relationship between the online impulse buying intention and atmospherics in virtual community. 264 valid participants do online survey and the research used partial least squares (PLS) analysis to test the model. The results reveal that atmospherics (navigational characteristics, informativeness, and entertainment) in virtual community have positive effects on online impulse buying intention. In addition, product type was found to moderate the effect of atmospherics on online impulse buying intention. Last, the study provides available suggestions for online community content providers.

articleTitle: A novel cloud based hospital health care service network framework with delay sensitive handoff guarantee
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: According the tremendous increasing of personal health care requirements, continuous monitoring of patients' health parameters is critical to make correct diagnoses, the traditional health care service system is inefficiency, untimely, and facing critical challenge. how to design a seamless wireless communication framework and powerful computing platform for healthcare service is critical. In this paper, we propose a novel cloud based service network infrastructure including BSN, WLAN and 3G/4G cellular network, a local mobile switch center of different access points in the same sub network is designed to assist the smooth handover between different APs, and a delayed time stamp data transmission mechanism is adopted when patients handoff between 3G/4G and WLAN, the performance of the proposed network and handoff scheme is simulated and the results show that the transmitted medical data can be recovered with good quality.

articleTitle: Evaluation of automotive supply chain risks: An empirical research
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper aims to investigate the vulnerability of supply chain and figure out the key supply chain risks by conducting an empirical study of supply risk management at Shanghai Automotive Industrial Company (SAIC), a large-scale automobile company in china. The analysis based on the survey conducted with SAIC and its downstream and upstream companies. Before carrying out the survey, we make the hypotheses of risk path models from four aspects i.e. supplier, manufacturer, distributor and customer. Then according to the data we collected, we verify the hypotheses and identify the supply chain risk factors using the Confirmatory Factor Analysis model. After that, we use the WBS-RBS method to evaluate the two-level risk factor model. And we find that supplier's financial risk, manufacturer's strategic risk, distributor's financial risk are the highest risk drivers. More explicitly, production cost increase contributes most to financial risk and unqualified R&D ability, less competitive product and inaccurate demand forecast can bring strategic risk for the core manufacturer, SAIC.

articleTitle: Integration of data mining techniques to evaluate promotion for mobile customers' data traffic in data plan
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Since Penetration rate of mobile phone rises quickly and China mobile telecomm market is almost becoming saturated increasingly, China mobile telecom operators are facing with a slow new subscribers' growth and a decline in the average revenue per user (ARPU). China mobile operators are developing strategies to supplement the tapering revenues by promoting mobile value-add service (VAS) and wireless data service in 4G system. In this paper the decision tree and neural network data mining technique are applied to evaluate the promotion of mobile customers' data traffic in data plan. To ensure the accuracy of the analysis, we use the decision tree and neural network algorithm to analyze data of over 120000 members, over ten provinces. The results show to be very valuable for making strategy recommendations to promote the customers' data traffic in data plan.

articleTitle: A comparative study of China and US users' acceptance of online payment
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: China and US both have developed online payment services, which have their own features due to the two countries' different culture, policies, and technical features etc. Therefore, it contributes to the great difference in the online payment users' perceptions of their domestic online payment in the two countries. According to previous studies of the technology acceptance model and the diffusion model of new technologies, we took privacy concern, perceived risk, perceived security, trust, perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness into consideration, and studied their influence on users' attitudes towards online payment. Subsequently, this paper built the Online Payment Acceptance Model for American and Chinese online payment users on the basis of Technology Acceptance Model (TAM). The empirical results shows that the influence of perceived risk, perceived security, trust, perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness on users' attitudes towards online payment are similar in the two countries. And it is worth noting that the influences of privacy concern on users' attitudes towards online payment in the two countries are different. In US, it is shown that privacy concern has significant negative impact on users' attitudes towards online payment. However, in China, it is not only shown that privacy concern has positive impact on users' attitudes towards online payment, but also shown that the impact is not statistically significant.

articleTitle: The impact of customer's cognitive level on brand's perceived value: Based on the research of eye movement experiment
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the growth of people's living standard and economic income, the effect of prices is weakened while customers are shopping, but brand effect is increasingly obvious. This paper uses the customers' brand cognitive level as independent variable, and uses simulation scenario experiment method and use the eye tracker to record and analyze the eye movement data of the participants of different cognitive levels during the process of choosing and buying different brands, then uses science methods to process and analyze dates, and find out the relationship between the customer's cognitive level and value perception of the brand. The results prove that improve customers' cognitive level of a brand can also improve the brand perceived value to them.

articleTitle: Recourse accounts receivable factoring financing ratio research based on multinational supply chain
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Factoring financing ratio is an important decision variable to banks and enterprises. The optimal factoring financing ratio can help banks obtain maximum profit under the lower risk and be benefit to enterprise operation. Our work established on domestic banks provide accounts receivable finance to the domestic small and medium enterprises. In this paper, we research banks' expectation profit and accounts receivable factoring financing ratio based on multinational supply chain composed of domestic suppliers and external retailers when they face the credit risk and exchange rate risk. The innovation of this paper is that we consider recourse factoring financing ratio and relevant influence factors. We analyze the factoring time, the exchange rate fluctuation, the compensation ratio and some other factors how to affect the factoring financing ratio.

articleTitle: The impact of the product safety crisis on shareholder wealth: Evidence from infant and child products industry
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The increase in the number of high-profile product safety incidents in recent years highlights the issue of ensuring product safety. While many studies have examined this issue in the Western context and the auto industry with a sample of product, little is known about the financial impact of a product safety crisis of infant child products industry in China. Using short-term event study method, this study investigates how product safety incidence (71 samples), which happened in infant & child industry in China, are associated with enterprise value. The study found that those product safety incidents have negative significant impact on share price (abnormal return=-0.62%) and crisis disclosed through the consumption suffer worse. Our findings indicate impact varies from event type and product recall has a greater impact than the national quality sampling, local quality inspection and quality inspection by social organization.

articleTitle: Understanding WeChat continuance usage from the perspectives of flow experience, self-control, and communication environment
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With advancement of the Internet, particularly Web 2.0 technologies, social networking sites (SNS) has enjoyed an unparalleled popularity, WeChat become a hot research topic in IS area in recent years. WeChat is, however, now facing fierce competition from `yixin', `weblog'. Thus it is of vital importance to do a research about the continuance usage of WeChat. The present study is aims to explore the role of flow experience, self-control, communication environment in driving users to continue using WeChat based on the expectation-confirmation model of information systems(ECM-IS/IT).

articleTitle: Exploring the local effects of helpful reviews on online product sales
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In order to reduce information uncertainty and search costs of customers, voting mechanism of useful reviews is adapted by many electronic business platforms. However, impact of such measure on sales is not yet clear. Our work addresses this issue by regression model of sales and variables of helpful reviews. The results indicate the significant influence of helpful reviews to sales. Helpful reviews with extreme ratings decrease sales, while the other reviews reveal the opposite effect.

articleTitle: The influence of corporate governance structure on the accounting information transparency: Based on the empirical evidence from manufacturing listing corporation
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Perfect corporate governance structure has a positive effect to the accounting information disclosure, accounting information disclosure is helpful to improve corporate governance and the transparency of the operation and management. By the Shenzhen manufacturing industry in 2005-2014 sample firms Logistic regression analysis, the results showed that the proportion of the first big shareholders, shares and the company scale is positively related to the accounting information transparency; Size of the board of supervisors and the accounting information transparency has no obvious correlation.

articleTitle: How to coordinate supply chain under O2O business model when demand deviation and retailer's sales cost deviation happen
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: A supply chain consisting of one supplier and one O2O retailer is studied in this paper. The retailer sells product to customers by using O2O e-commerce platform and customers receive the product offline. The supply chain is coordinated under the quantity discount contract in stable case. Disruption makes the price sensitivity coefficient and the retailer's sales cost change simultaneously after the production plan in the supply chain is formulated. In centralized supply chain, the supplier only needs to adjust the retail price if the deviations satisfy certain condition. The supplier needs to adjust the retail price and the production quantities if the deviations are large enough. In decentralized decision, the supply chain cannot be coordinated. This means that the original quantity discount contract cannot coordinate the disrupted O2O supply chain. An improved quantity discount contract which is used to coordinate the disrupted supply chain is put forward. The research shows that the improved contract can coordinate the original supply chain and the disrupted supply chain, which means that the contract has robustness when facing the price sensitivity coefficient deviation and the retailer's sales cost deviation. Finally, some numerical examples are shown.

Author Keywords: demand deviation and retailer's sales cost deviation

articleTitle: A fuzzy-based recommendation system for cloud accounting service
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: As an emerging cloud service, cloud accounting can offer accounting solution and save much operation cost, which becomes popular among enterprises of all sizes. Facing with different cloud accounting providers, consumers with little domain knowledge have difficulties in choosing the suitable provider that can match their requirements. Therefore, developing a recommendation system can be a good way to differentiate various suppliers. While there is little history purchasing information in the newly-developed cloud accounting market, the paper proposes a reclusive-approach recommendation system, using only preference information of user of interest. This personalized recommendation system is able to measure and rate the alternative cloud accounting providers in terms of the ability to satisfy the certain consumer preferences. In the proposed system, triangular fuzzy set is used to help both consumers express their preferences and experts evaluate provider ability. Example results show that the system is feasible and reliable.

articleTitle: Research On Improved DEMATEL method considering preference consistency
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In order to effectively deal with ignoring the experts preference consistency problems in the process of constructing the direct judgment matrix of the current DEMATEL method. In view of the current situation shown characteristics of “decision - oriented pluralism”, “project attribute heterogeneity” and “decision making information diversity” in complex decision making, analyzing two dimensions on controllability of the decision making process and the effectiveness of experts interaction to form overall reflection on the integration strategy of preference consistency check. Giving the overall preference consistency check method of the initial judgment information and multi-round inconsistent decision making information adjustment strategy based on the whole decision making information judgment strategy and the paired factors comparison information sequence conversion strategy. Case application of the key influence factors identification of public information service platform construction indicates, the above mentioned methods and strategies are effective and feasible, they may provide reference for the DEMATEL method in direct influence matrix structure process of the experts group check, adjustment and aggregation.

articleTitle: Study on reverse supply chain management and evaluation model for iron and steel industry: From perspective of the coordination management of industrial cluster
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Iron and steel industry is a major industrial waste emitter in China, which is of the basis, potential and practical significance to construct reverse supply chain system owing to the higher recycling value of waste iron and steel. With the theory of reverse supply chain coordination management and comprehensive performance evaluation of circular economy, this paper study the internal and external reverse supply chain modules of iron and steel industry and their integration from the perspective of the internal and external coordination innovation management. An evaluation model of reverse supply chain system is constructed for the sake of evaluating the construction progress of reverse supply chain in iron and steel industry. With the case of Baoshan iron & steel firm, using the above models, this paper analyzes and evaluates the progress of reverse supply chain construction. The results show that, firstly, the built steel reverse supply chain system and evaluation models may reflect and evaluate the construction progress of reverse supply chain system in Baoshan iron & steel firm; secondly, it has a value of reference and great significance to improve the construction of reverse supply chain system in iron and steel industry.

articleTitle: Research on Micro-credit risks of Rural Commercial Banks in China: A case study of ‘A’ RCB
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Non-performing Loan (NPL) Ratio of Rural Commercial Banks in China is higher than average among all commercial banks. Micro-credit is one of main loan business of Rural Commercial Banks. This paper is based on 11,621 pieces of Micro-credit data from 16 branches of ‘A’ RCB and analyzes the affecting factors of Credit-default risks, by choosing 10 indexes from two big categories of Farmers' basic characteristics & Credit condition and building binary logistic regression. The analysis result shows that five variables of ED (Education Degree), FI (Family Income), IC (Industry Categories), LP (Loan Payment) and LT (Loan Time) are main factors that affect PD (Probability of Default) of micro-credit of ‘A’ RCB.

articleTitle: Channel selection of a fresh product supply chain with consumer preferences
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper builds a dual channel supply chain which consists of a manufacturer and a retailer selling a fresh product, and analyzes the optimal decisions of supply chain with multiple sales channels. Then based on the mathematical results, we study the impact of some factors on the optimal decisions of supply chain, such as customers' sensitivity to the freshness of fresh product, consumers' sensitivity to the service level of fresh product, consumers' sensitivity to the price of fresh product, consumers' acceptance to network marketing channel. Finally we carry on numerical analysis, and compare the profit of supply chain in different consumers' acceptance to network marketing channel, and study the impact of freshness of fresh product and preservation costs on transport.

articleTitle: The vehicle routing for power grid material distribution: A case study in China
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper investigates the material distribution problem of Chinese Power Grid Companies. We first analyze the characteristic of power grid material in terms of their distribution network, timeliness and inventory control. Then we illustrate the workflow of the whole distribution process, including material application, allocation, routes planning and order tracking. To solve the vehicle routing problem (VRP), a skewed variable neighborhood search (SVNS) algorithm is developed. A Distribution Management System is also designed to fulfill the whole workflow. We apply it to the case study, and the results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm is capable of generating more reasonable vehicle routes and the system can help the company to reduce labor intensity and to improve efficiency.

articleTitle: A framework of data mining for logging reservoir evaluation
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Data mining provides an automatic and effective way for reservoir evaluation based on well logging interpretation. In this paper, we propose a framework of data mining for logging reservoir evaluation and verify its performance on two well logging dataset. Experimental results show that the conclusions of well-logging interpretation by the framework proposed in this paper are consistent with the test oil results. Compared with traditional evaluation methods, it is efficient and not so dependent on expertise. This framework provides a reference for the construction of big data platform for oil exploration and development.

articleTitle: Analyzing the influencing factors of mobile game consumption
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the increase of the number of people playing mobile phone games, mobile games is becoming more and more attention. As the mobile game itself provides a highly engaging environment, this study examines mobile game consumption from the perspective of customer engagement. We propose a research model that examines why game players actively engage in playing mobile games, and how such engagement can contribute to sales of mobile games, empirically testing the model using 213 mobile game players. The results support our research hypotheses and illustrate the effect of customer engagement on stimulating game players' spending in mobile games. The findings of this study are expected to provide some suggestions for game developers and publishers on promoting the sales of items/goods.

articleTitle: Influence of aesthetics on consumer decision
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: ERPs (Event-related Potentials) were used to study the influence of aesthetics on consumer purchase decision when product appearance is pitted against attributes that are more determinative of product performance. In this study, consumers should decide whether to buy the products with appearance and performance information in an online-shopping experiment. The stimuli were divided into four configurations based on the consistency of appearance (aesthetic vs. standardized) and performance (superior performance vs. inferior performance). Results showed that configurations with aesthetic appearance have higher purchase rate than configurations with standardized appearance. Although all configurations evoked conflict-related N270, conflicting configurations elicited higher amplitude of N270 in the prefrontal regions. Aesthetics-related P2 were also elicited among posterior-parietal regions in all configurations, but the amplitude of P2 was not consistent with the purchase rate. Interesting enough, aesthetic-inferior configuration has higher perchase rate and lower amplitude of N270 than standardized-superior configuration. The results show that product appearance has positive impact on consumer decision and prove that consumers have the expectation that aesthetic products are also functionally superior. The findings explained the neurological and psychological activities when consumers are browsing products. Hence, P2 and N270 may be useful neural endogenous indicator for consumer purchase decision.

articleTitle: Threshold based query strategies for QoS-aware service composition in dynamic service networks
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: A challenging task in Service Oriented Computing (SOC) is the selection of the best combination of services that fulfills user's requirements while meeting quality of service (QoS) constraints, i.e. QoS-aware automatic service composition (ASC). This challenge becomes more complex when dealing with various kinds of QoS fluctuation. In this paper, we propose two threshold based query strategies for QoS-aware service composition in dynamic service networks. The strategies, one uses the number of global dynamic services as a threshold, and the more sophisticated one regards the number of dynamic services that affect network structure as a threshold, are applied to decide under which circumstance, either reconstruction or partial adaption to certain Web services construction would show the better performance. We use the Web service dataset provided in the 2009 Web Service Challenge to evaluate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed strategies. And the experiments show the well performance of our approach.

articleTitle: Vegetables price forecasting in Hainan province based on linear and nonlinear combination model
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With Hainan vegetables price from 2012 to 2015 as the research object, Back Propagation (BP) neural network forecasting model and Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) forecasting model of Hainan vegetables price are set up. Based on above two models, linear combination and nonlinear combination forecasting model of vegetables price are established by linear programming method and BP neural network method. The results indicate that nonlinear combination model is superior to linear combination model, and linear combination model is superior to any single model, reflecting that combination model can make individual models complement each other's advantages to improve prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Energy minimization vehicle routing problem with heterogeneous vehicles
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Transportation is more and more important in social and economic development. However, it also causes resource waste and environment pollution problems as well. Hence, it is necessary to take energy consumption minimization into consideration when we deal with vehicle routing problems (VRP). Most of previous researches about energy minimization vehicle routing problem (EMVRP) assume that the vehicles are homogeneous and every vehicle should be used. This paper considers EMVRP with heterogeneous vehicles. And we also propose that not all vehicles should be used. Two mixed integer programming models are formulated for the problem: a cumulative-energy based formulation and a parallel-machine scheduling based model. Computational experiments are conducted to compare the performance of both models and show that not using all vehicles can have a better energy consumption.

articleTitle: Pricing and production strategies for fashion tech products with consumption externalities
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the rapid development of technology, more and more products tend to both meet customers' functional needs and provide stylish consumption experience at the same time. In this paper, we define these products as “fashion tech” products. In practice there exist two opposite consumption externalities associated with “fashion tech” products: some people are more likely to purchase the product if fewer customers can afford or have access to it to advertise their prosperity or good taste. In contrast, some other people's utilities increase with the rising number of other customers. The firm needs to consider such consumption externalities in their pricing and production decisions in order to appropriately position products and maximize profits. In such context, this paper studies equilibrium conditions based on the newsvendor model under rational expectations, then optimizes pricing and production strategies for the products. We finally propose a plan for further research with some open questions.

articleTitle: Cooperative games in an integrated system with multiple hospitals
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In this paper, we present a approach to study the cooperative games among the hospitals, and formulate it as a stochastic linear programming problem. In the basic model, each hospital has their own capacity (the Operating Room) locally and has several surgery teams facing random demands. The proposed method with duality theory is applied to show the nonemptiness of the core and suggests a way to find an element in the core.

articleTitle: Research on the financing mode of small and micro enterprises basing on the peer-to-peer lending
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: As a new financial format, peer-to-peer lending(P2P lending) solve the financing problems of small and micro enterprises to a certain extent. This paper analyses the pure online financing mode and the combination of online and offline financing mode of small and micro enterprises under the P2P lending. The paper discusses the advantages and disadvantages of various financing models. Basing on a case, the article further analysis the advantages and disadvantages of the small and micro enterprise financing mode under the P2P lending, puts forward the countermeasures that can promote the healthy development of small and micro enterprises financing mode.

articleTitle: Minimizing total cost in outpatient scheduling with unpunctual arrivals
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In the literature, researchers usually assume that late outpatients are not accepted by hospitals. Although this assumption simplifies models by making them analytically tractable, it rarely holds true for most clinics. This paper introduces a back row policy for late outpatients, and evaluates performance improvements from its incorporation into commonly studied appointment rules. We use simulations to obtain the expectations of patients' waiting time and doctor's idle time, and present the results in the form of efficient frontier. Through pre-established procedures, we are able to identify the optimal rule of appointment scheduling under given parameters.

articleTitle: Clustering analysis of dangerous goods transportation of logistics platform based on improved K-means algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved K-means algorithm for the clustering analysis of dangerous goods transportation from logistics platform. The improved algorithm uses the distance dissimilarity between clusters to gain cluster coefficient, K, in order to avoid poor clustering effectiveness caused by the subjective K-value settings. And the improved algorithm also uses the spatial data feature extraction to build properties and achieves the normalization of spatial data. It aims to avoid impact of a large number of irregular spatial data on the clustering effectiveness. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated by a cluster analysis example, which includes the dangerous goods transport data from Chinese logistics information platform.

articleTitle: A study of distributed inventory system based on VMI strategy under emergency conditions
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: To find a more effective strategy of managing distributed inventory system under emergency conditions, we combine Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) with a Hierarchical, Distributed, Dynamic, Inventory management (HDDI) scheme to manage distributed inventory system with decentralized control. Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) strategy is introduced into a typical distributed inventory system with modified HDDI scheme to increase information sharing of the system. We use system dynamics to simulate the distributed inventory system with VMI and HDDI strategy under emergency conditions. It shows that the distributed inventory system based on VMI and modified HDDI strategy can meet emergency requirements and has lower inventory, compared with traditional inventory system. In addition, a buffer stock mechanism is used in discussed system to balance the contradiction between fill rate and cost under emergency conditions.

articleTitle: A simulation study of appointment scheduling for multi-class MRI examination
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The inefficiency in the use of expensive resource such as Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) will lead to long delays in patient examination which has potential influence on patients care. The main purpose of this study is to improve MRI utilization and to reduce the waiting time of patients including outpatients, inpatients and emergency patients. Scheduling rules are designed on the basis of different facility-level and multi-class examinations. As a result, assigning examination tasks according to the difference of facilities and setting fixed service time can balance examination tasks. Considering the randomness of emergency patients' arrive rate, reasonable slacking time slots performs better, compared with setting reserved time slots. Besides, setting the length of time slots equal to the length of service time can increase the number of served patients and not increase the waiting time of patients obviously.

articleTitle: Mechanism of agent evaluation based on infinite repeated game
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In addition to China bid evaluation subject of the legal responsibilities and rights are not equal, the bid evaluation committee's temporary and project the long-term is contradictory. Therefore, when the tenderee was not satisfied with the evaluation results, it is difficult to recover and responsibility to their own interests. In view of the present evaluation mechanism based on the bid evaluation committee, there are not experts in the same level, it is difficult for experts to make a comprehensive evaluation of the tender documents in a limited time, and the evaluation effect is not obvious and so on. The article analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of Individual evaluation and agent evaluation, and then points out the discount factor on the tenderee and bid evaluation agent from the game, proves that the feasibility of bid evaluation agent, finally constructs the basic countermeasures of agent evaluation. It opens up a new perspective to further standardize the bidding market mechanism.

articleTitle: Supply chain investments in capacity construction and disruption prevention
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With increasingly intensive competition in nowadays global market environment, components outsourcing becomes a normal production plan for manufacturers. How to secure capacity procurement throughout the supply chain proves to be an essential task. As the central member of a supply chain, the manufacturer has the urge to achieve capacity investment balance between himself and his supplier. When the manufacturer invests in capacity, one major concern is whether the supplier could improve her capacity accordingly. As the supplier intends to invest less than the manufacturer's expectation for the sake of less risk exposure. This paper studies how do the manufacturer and the supplier make an appropriate amount of investment in capacity construction. Other than the uneven capacity investment issue, how to deal with the disruption risk is also of vital significance. In this paper we investigate, taking disruption into consideration, how will the supply chain members react if precautions like disruption prevention investment is available. Examining the supply chain system of one manufacturer and one supplier, where both members are under disruption risk, this paper studies how to achieve the optimal investments in capacity construction and disruption prevention.

articleTitle: Design and application of taxi intelligent integrated service and management information system
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Directing at the problems of taxi service and management, the taxi intelligent integrated service and management information system (TIISMIS) is designed. TIISMIS is composed of two subsystems, taxi vehicle intelligent service system (TVISS) and taxi supervision and operation analysis system (TSOAS). TVISS and TSOAS are connected via wireless network system. By using a set of special on-board operation equipment, TVISS is mainly responsible for collecting the accurate taxi driver attendance data, taxi detailed operating data, quality of driver service appraise data, passenger traffic volume survey data, dynamic inspection data and alarm data. At the same time, these data are real-time transmitted to the TSOAS for processing and analysis. TSOAS is mainly responsible for the data mining process, the monitoring and dispatching command of the taxi, the timely response to the on-call service. System application results show that the system can improve the scientific of the management and decision-making, strengthen the dispatching of the taxi, and thus improve the service level of the taxi and passenger satisfaction.

articleTitle: The effectiveness of online shopping characteristics and logistics service on satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Online shopping has grown rapidly in recent years. However, researches of online customers continue to show that many remain unsatisfied with their online purchase experiences. Clearly, more researches are needed to better understand what affects customers' evaluations of their online experiences. Using a survey research with 183 participants, we investigate the importance of product uncertainty, retailer visibility and logistics services in customers' online purchase decisions, as well as the mitigating effects of retailer characteristics. We found that high product uncertainty has an impact on customer satisfaction but not significant. Logistics services and retailer visibility play an important role on customer satisfaction when buying an experience product. Service quality and customer reviews can mitigate the negative impact of product uncertainty, retailer visibility. However, products' price helps little on that.

articleTitle: The study on the brand earnings' features of growth corporate brand: Based on an empirical analysis in apparel industry
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Nowadays, corporate brands were facing the problems of short life cycle, slowdown in incomes growth. The research of the growth corporate brand's main features and development restriction could help to cultivate and promote the growth and sustainable development of corporate brand, and to prolong the life of apparel corporate brand. Growth corporate brand has been made out by using life cycle model through the analysis of the financial data belonged to 61 apparel corporate brands. According to the analysis of the empirical results, the variation features of the growth brand's brand earnings have been obtained, which had some reference value for the growth and development of corporate brand.

articleTitle: A model of signaling quality in supply chains by corporate social responsibility
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper studies a supply chain consisting of an upstream supplier, a downstream retailer and final consumers. The supplier owns privately the information on the product quality level and signals it by CSR strategy. Under this quality information asymmetry, in order to examine the role of CSR on signaling the quality level, we build a signaling model to capture how the supplier indirectly share the quality information by its CSR strategy, and characterize the separate equilibriums. The equilibrium results show that under some technical conditions, a high enough CSR level signals a high quality level in the sense of a separate equilibrium, which provides supply chain managers with an implication on choosing a direct or an indirect way to sharing information conditional on a known cost of direct information sharing.

articleTitle: Dynamic path optimization algorithm based on spatial-temporal and genetic factor
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Dynamic path optimization method has long been regarded as one of the toughest yet pervasive problems in urban computing. The conjunct effects of spatial-temporal and genetic factor in path optimization are with few researches. To meet this critical challenge, in this paper, we pay a systematic study on the different classifier performance in class overlapping problem and propose a new dynamic path optimization method based on spatial-temporal and genetic factor. The algorithm keeps the neighborhood in traditional tabu algorithm, ensure strong climbing ability and go to the local optimization. At the same time, introduce the spatial-temporal and genetic factor to develop new search space for bounded domain considering spatial-temporal. Experimental results on selected data sets prove that dynamic path optimization algorithm based on spatial-temporal and genetic factor can have good performance for dynamic path optimization problem.

articleTitle: Financing amount and influence factors analysis in IT industry
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the development of IT industry and the innovation of entrepreneurship, it also becomes more important that whether can the entrepreneurs receive the financing they expect. In this paper, we acquire information from the web ITJUZI.com and use the classifier to analyze the financing amount level and the influence factors of venture capital. The results show that the accuracy of J48 classifier can reach 77.4%. Besides, Round, Field and Age are more relevant to financing amount. According to the results, we propose some guiding suggestions for investors and entrepreneurs to help them making decision.

articleTitle: Comparison on the dynamic adjustment behaviors of cash holdings of listed companies in the perspective of growth
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the data of 435 non-financial listed companies of Shanghai and Shenzhen from 2007-2012, this paper compares the dynamic adjustment behaviors of cash holdings in the perspective of growth, which include the adjustment speeds and forms. We find that there is optimal level of cash holdings, and the average adjustment speed of cash holdings for high-growth sample companies is 0.356, which is faster than low-growth samples (0.329), while the adjustment form has a certain similarity. The results show that compared with the foreign companies with more developed capital market, the adjustment speed of cash holdings of listed companies in China is slower, which overall lags behind, presents a special phenomenon of adjustment in continuous single direction.

articleTitle: The space production of rural society under the background of China's urbanization
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: During the rapid urbanization process, villages are undergoing the problem of deprovincialization and promoted the pace of the end of the village in China. Rethinking from the space production of the government, developers and residents in the process of space production leads to the profound consideration of the loss of regional culture, the differentiation of social space structure and so on. Analysis the relationship between interest subjects, reshape the space behavior and the corresponding countermeasures were put forward in this paper.

articleTitle: A reputation evaluation method for supplier selection
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Cooperating with trustworthy suppliers is one of effective methods for enterprise to improve competitiveness in the global economy. A lot of evaluation methods for selecting suppliers have been presented in academic literatures, but a few considered the supplier's reputation as an evaluation index. As reputation plays a critical role in human social activities, it is similarly regarded as an important role in virtual network world. An evaluation framework of suppliers' reputation is presented in this paper and also a new reputation evaluation method which is based on the evidence and supervised by experience (E-E method) is put forward. Finally, simulation and analysis are shown to prove the validation of this method.

articleTitle: Spillover effects of Japanese monetary policy on China: Is there any differences during and aftermath of crisis?
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper examines the spillover effects of Japanese monetary policy on Chinese macro economy - during and in the aftermath of 2007–2008 financial crisis. Study periods are divided into two: from January 2007 to January 2013 as the first period and from April 2013 to December 2015 as the second one. The reason why we take 2013 as threshold is that since 2013, Japan executed more radical quantitative easing policy and China experienced an obvious slow economic growth and deepen market oriented interest rate reform and exchange rate reform. The results of VAR model analysis shows that Japanese monetary policy did have spillover effects on China economy, while behavior of two stages were different. Japanese monetary policy mainly affected Chinese money supply, exchange rates and interest rates at the first stage, while it mainly affected Chinese output and trade level at the second stage.

articleTitle: A study on the effect of non-interest income and its components on the performance of listed banks in China
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Based on the panel data of 13 listed banks from 2007 to 2014, this paper analyzes the effect of non-interest income and its components on banks from the aspect of earnings. The empirical results show that, for state-owned banks, the development of non-interest business has a positive but not significant impact on return on assets and for share-holding banks, the development of non-interest income has a significantly negative impact on risk-adjusted returns.

articleTitle: A research on financing efficiency of enterprises in NEEQ market
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Since 2013, NEEQ market has become an important financing channel for many small scale enterprises with the explosive growth in these years. As an essential part of multi-level capital market in China, NEEQ market provides efficient financing platform for listed enterprises. So, it's very important to conduct a research on the financing efficiency of enterprises in NEEQ market. This paper selects the 32 companies which issue directional stock the first time in 2013, excluding a ST company, and we ultimately determine the 31 companies as a sample. We use the DEA (data envelopment analysis) method in the BCC model to measure, calculate, and analyze the efficiency of NEEQ market. Then the technical (comprehensive) efficiency can compose to pure technical efficiency and scale efficiency to do an evaluation. Finally, we explore the causes of the inefficient enterprise financing activities in NEEQ market from the perspective of industry and output index.

articleTitle: Re-design innovation services in fashion supply chain: Motivated by an online fashion marketplace
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Product design is the key to attract consumers in fashion. To enhance product image, many E-commerce marketplaces may provide re-design innovation service to enhance the products' original design according to the marketplaces' promotion themes. The extant literature shows that the better quality of re-design innovation can attract more consumers to buy products in the e-commerce marketplaces. In this paper, motivated by the real practices of re-design innovation services in an online B2B textile fabric marketplace in China, we examine how the re-design innovation affects a service supply chain in the fashion industry. We develop an analytical model and consider that the re-design innovation service can significantly increase the sales number of products. We derive the optimal retail price and the optimal re-design innovation effort under the revenue sharing contract and entry fee contract, which are commonly adopted in industry. We find that both revenue sharing portion and entry fee can enhance the degree of re-design innovation efforts. More managerial insights are discussed.

articleTitle: Impact of “Horizontal—Vertical” social norms on performance behavior: Based on a Simplified Trust Experiment
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: From the perspective of social preference of paying attention to the behavior of others and concerning the process, behavioral economists analyze the impact of social preference on the behavior of heterogeneous individuals. This paper provides a simplified trust experiment in the background of the lending market, using the evaluation for “Horizontal” and “Vertical” norms to measure the rule preference of individuals. According to the repayment decision in the experiment to investigate the impacts of rule preference on the performance. The results of the experiment show that: “Horizontal - Vertical” social norm have a significant influence on performance, and the individuals prefer “Horizontal” preference performance better than the “Vertical” ones.

articleTitle: The optimization of kernel function and its parameters for SVM in well-logging
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Support Vector Machine (SVM) is an effective method for reservoir layer classification. However, its classification performance is influenced by many factors. In this paper, we study how the main factors affect classification accuracy of SVM on oil data. We collect two well-logging dataset, use k-Cross Validation and Grid Search to find the optimal SVM parameters, and compare the classification performance of different kernel function. The experiment results show that the type of kernel function affects classification rate most and Polynomial performs best.

articleTitle: On customer satisfaction of school bus based on Kano model: A case study in Shanghai
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: As the use of school buses is becoming more and more extensive, schools and bus service providers begin to pay more attention to the development of school buses, they need to improve the school buses to meet students' requirements. Studying the factors which affect satisfaction or dissatisfaction of students and finding ways to improve satisfaction as well as to reduce dissatisfaction is of vital importance. To summarize students' needs and classify attributes of school buses, the Kano model is used to analyze school buses of East China University of Science and Technology. Three approaches to Kano model are used to categorize the school buses attributes as must-be quality, one-dimensional quality, attractive quality and indifferent quality. By using the rule M>O>A>I, schools and bus service providers could decide the priorities of different attributes to improve satisfaction of students according to the result.

articleTitle: Manufacturer investment in cost reduction and supplier information sharing
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Consider a supply chain setting consisting of a manufacturer and a supplier, in which the former can invest to reduce the latter's production cost, but the cost information is proprietary to the latter. Whether the supplier commits to share his information will have an influence on the manufacturer's investment. Therefore, this paper investigates the relationship between the manufacturer's investment and the supplier's information sharing. By modeling, we discuss how the profits of supply chain members change under the various investment levels in two information sharing ways, that is, with pre-commitment and without pre-commitment, respectively. Our results indicate that, with pre-commitment, the supplier will always choose withhold his information; but without pre-commitment, whether the supplier shares his information depends on the manufacturer's investment level. Generally, the higher investment level, the broader the cost range for disclosure. Moreover, the profits of both supplier and manufacturer are always higher with pre-commitment than without it, which means pre-commitment is more effective to achieve win-win.

articleTitle: An empirical analysis on business performance of electrical appliance enterprises with “Home Appliance Going to the Countryside” policy
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The domestic manufacturing has excessively dependent on the export trading. The 2008 financial crisis has led to a dramatic decrease in the export trading and slowed down the development of the domestic appliance industry. As stimulating domestic demand is around the corner, the state has adopted a policy of “Home Appliance Going to the Countryside(HAGC)” in 2007. On account of this background, to investigate how the policy of HAGC impact on the business performance of electrical appliance enterprises and provide some suggestions for the subsequent new policy, we collected the annual report data of 15 electrical appliance enterprises involved in the policy of “Home Appliance Going to the Countryside”. After the descriptive statistical analysis and the regression analysis we found that the policy of HAGC has a positive impact on the business performance of electrical appliance enterprises and has a significant impact on the business performance in the year to participate policy, but it has a hysteresis effect on the operational performance of the electrical appliance enterprises.

Author Keywords: The policy of “Home Appliance Going to the Countryside”

articleTitle: Empirical study on industry client's importance and Audit independence
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper use possibility of strict audit opinion issued for the client to measure Audit independence, inspected relationship between consolidation client's importance and Audit independence in 1 year before and after the accounting firm merger, Visiting accounting firms merge and client's importance does have a significant impact on auditor independence under the merge. The empirical results show that the accounting firm merger before and after 1 year, as the industry client's importance reduced, the auditor will more inclined to issued strict audit opinion. It suggests that there was a significant negative correlation between industry client's importance with the Audit independence during before and after the merger period.

articleTitle: Research and exploration of coal enterprise management-control model in subsidiary view
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Promote the merger and reorganization of coal enterprises and improving coal industry concentration is currently the main development trend of coal enterprises in China. However, with the control problems are increasing. At present, the scholars often research and exploration of coal enterprise management-control model in subsidiary view. This article combines with CCNH case to analyze main problems of coal enterprise management-control model in subsidiary view. Secondly, on the basis of the previous scholars study, the article build double-dimension subsidiary roles model through strategic importance and their own ability including four kinds of subsidiary: the leading subsidiary, developing subsidiary, contributing subsidiary and pioneering subsidiary. Through analysis of specific cases CCNH coal company to match its four subsidiary, it provide evidence for different subsidiary for different control models according to subsidiary role model, so as to provide new ideas to solve control problems of coal enterprises.

articleTitle: The effect of venture capital on earnings management of GEM IPOs in China
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In order to reveal that whether venture capital could influence earnings management made by listed companies around IPO and whether venture capital could reduce the degree of earnings management during the process of IPO, this paper has focused on the relationship between venture capital and earnings management and selected 356 companies listed in Shenzhen GEM during 2010–2014 as samples. Using modified Cross Sectional Jones Model, this paper does a regression to calculate sample companies' discretionary accruals (DA) as a measure of earnings management. Through the analysis of multiple linear regression model which includes 2 explanatory variables, it comes to the conclusion that compared with non-VC-backed companies, VC-backed companies showed less earnings management in the year before IPO.

articleTitle: The spatial patterns and interactions between industrial development and energy consumption in Shandong peninsula urban agglomeration
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the production values of the secondary and tertiary industries and 18 industries, and the amount of energy consumption of 8 cities in Shandong peninsula urban agglomeration in 2014, The Theil index, data envelopment analysis, correlation analysis, stepwise multiple regression analysis and ArcGIS spatial analysis were applied to study the spatial patterns of the industrial development and energy consumption and their interactions. The conclusions are: (1) The balance degree of industrial development and the energy consumption have obvious spatial differentiation characteristics and they are not related to each other. (2) The technical efficiency without economies of scale of Weihai and Qingdao are highest, the technical efficiency with economies of scale of Qingdao, Yantai and Weihai are highest and those of Zibo and Rizhao are lowest; the scale efficiency of Weihai, Jinan, Qingdao, Dongying and Rizhao are high. (3) The total amount of energy consumption is closely related to building industry, information transmission, computer services and software industry, wholesale and retail trade, accommodation and catering industry, the financial sector, culture, sports and entertainment. (4)The industries of manufacturing, culture, sports and entertainment have the strongest explanatory to the total amount of energy consumption.

articleTitle: Mixed 0–1 programming model for three parallel machines scheduling problem with machine-dependent unavailable constraints
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: We consider a three parallel machines scheduling problem with machine-dependent unavailable constraints where the machines are subject to periodic unavailable constraint, tool change constraint, and flexible periodic unavailable constraint, respectively. The objective is to minimize makespan, i.e., the completion time of the last finished job. We present a mixed 0-1 programming model with computational experiments for the problem.

articleTitle: Methods of determining search area for SAR at sea
