publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Based on the mental accounting theory, we frame decision problems of retailer under uncertain supply and stock-dependent demand and analyze the effect of some parameters on the retailer's optimal decision. After the analysis of the uncertainty, we propose a method called advanced payment to reduce the risk of the supply uncertainty. Our research shows that under the advanced payment strategy, the problem exists an optimal solution. With numerical study, we show that under the mental accounting behavior model, when the retailer's cost of capital in an acceptable range, the retailer will take the advanced payment strategy.

articleTitle: Analysis of gift cards effectiveness from a newsvendor's perspective
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Gift card is more and more popular in market, the retailer gets profit from gift cards, customers give gift cards to replace gift products. In this paper, we develop a newsvendor model to analysis the retailer's optimal strategy in condition that without gift cards, unredeemed gift card balances become the retailer's property with gift cards and unredeemed gift card balances become the state's property with gift cards, respectively. Then we make a numerical example analysis to compare the solutions in three different conditions and analysis the effects of different parameters to the solutions. We find the optimal order quantities in different conditions and selling gift cards is benefit to the retailer.

articleTitle: Research to the influential factors of the scale of financing lease under the background of Shanghai free trade zone financial reform
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper analysis datas coming from listed companies of A shares in China from 2010 to 2014. In 2013, under the background of Shanghai FTZ set up, it discusses the factors influencing the decision of financing lease whether impact scale of the listed companies financing lease of China, from this study, we found that: the tax rate presents the positive significant correlation between the size of financing lease, the company size present negative significant correlation between the size of financing lease. This will analysis of after Shanghai FTZ financial reform, the size of the financing lease to the influence factors for the improvement of the management policy.

articleTitle: The Public service system for the disabled in China: Problems and countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The establishment of the public service system for the disabled is an important part in the current development of undertakings for the disabled in China. There exit several problems in the establishment at this stage: lack of public service concept for the disabled, insufficient attention to the protection of the disabled people's right, the unitary and unclear main part of the public service and the imbalanced public service for the disabled. For these problems, the suggestions are made: set up the service concept of public interest supreme; establish the rights-based value orientation; emphasis the value criteria of equity priority; construct multi-cooperation service system for the disabled and complete the public service duty system for the disabled.

Author Keywords: the public service for the disabled

articleTitle: Extracting enterprises collaborative network from massive online documents
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: As the information technology has achieved great promotion in recent years, especially Chinese ICT industry is closely related to information technology is changing faster and faster. As a result, IT related enterprises become more and more dependent on efficient information delivery. To better grasp the more complex market opportunities, enterprises are inclined to collaborate with each other, for an alliance is more resistant to complex market occasion. In this article, we will try to extract the enterprises collaborative network from massive online data through data mining. After that, we introduce graph model to study the features of the network. Then, both the features of the whole industry and the status of different kinds of corporations can be adequately presented.

articleTitle: Capital market imperfections, income inequality and economic growth: A model approach
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper develops a model of growth and income inequalities in the presence of imperfect capital markets. It is shown that in the presence of credit market imperfections and indivisibilities in investment in human capital with limited wealth constraints on the part of the borrowers is the source of both capital market imperfections and the emergence of persistent income inequalities. The models suggest income inequality can lead to a lower economic growth and through enhancing the investment opportunity effect that fosters growth. So the policy-makers can design a policy that can improve economic efficiency by redistributing the wealth.

articleTitle: The mediator role of innovative self-efficacy between person-organization fit and innovative behavior
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This study surveyed 316 employees in Beijing, Tianjin, Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Shanghai by using questionnaire to obtain the empirical analysis data to study the effects of the person-organization fit on employees' innovative behavior and the the mediator role of innovative self-efficacy between the two. The paper finds that the higher person-organization fit degree is, the stronger innovative self-efficacy is, the more innovative behavior employees will perform and the innovative self-efficacy is the mediator role between person-organization fit and employees' innovative behavior. Analysis of the mediator role of the innovative self-efficacy between person-organization fit and employees' innovative behavior can produce a new insight for organization managers to promote employees' innovative behavior.

articleTitle: The value of pool factoring in capital-constrained supply chain
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: As a new supply chain financing tool, pool factoring is used to mitigate the increasingly serious imbalance between capital supply and demand. In order to explore the significance of pool factoring, we establish a two-echelon financial supply chain game model with a factor and a supplier, considering capital constraint, factor's decision objective is capital return maximization, then we obtain the equilibrium solution. We find that pool factoring provides incentives for participants and broaden the cooperation space of the financial and real economy; However, our study also shows pool factoring can't change the rule that factor dominate in financing under capital constraint.

articleTitle: External regulation and the quality of internal control: An empirical analysis of China's A-share markets
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: I examine whether external regulation has an impact on the quality of internal control of listed corporations. Both formal and informal mechanisms are used to measure external regulation. Formal mechanism includes legal system and government intervention. Informal mechanism includes media attention. The quality of internal control is measured by DIB internal control index of the listed corporations in China. The results indicate that formal external regulation significantly affects the quality of internal. But the role of the informal mechanism is not enough.

articleTitle: When are the buyers willing to post comments on an online feedback system? The moderating effects of online interactivity between buyers and sellers
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This article examines the moderating effects of online interactivity between buyers and sellers, focusing on when buyers are willing to post comments, especially favorable comments on an online feedback system. Results show: in high online interactivity between buyers and sellers, satisfaction positively influences buyers' willingness of favorable comments but with no influence on general comment willingness, while material incentives positively influences general comment willingness but with no influence on favorable comment willingness. However, executive cost negatively influences favorable comments and general comment willingness regardless of the level of interactivity. This paper contributes to the WOM literature and interaction theory.

articleTitle: Service awards and the market value of the firm: An empirical investigation
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper empirically estimates the impact of service quality on the market value of the firm. We use a firm's receipt of a service award as a proxy for its service effectiveness. Based on data from 232 announcements of service awards given to the company between 2006 and 2015, we find that award announcements are associated with statistically significant positive stock market reactions. Our results show that the stock market reacts on the day of the announcements is 0.47% depending on the market model used to estimate the abnormal returns. The market reaction is more positive for service firms and for firms whose service objects are companies.

articleTitle: The competition situation analysis of environmental service industry in China: Based on Porter's Five Forces Model
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Faced with serious industrial pollution and ecological damage, China has been developing environmental industry to solve these problems in recent decades. Environmental service, as one of the most rapidly growing part of environmental industry, has been playing more critical role in economic sustainability. This paper, based on Michael Porter's Five Forces Model theory for assessing the competitive environment and situation of an industry, illustrates the main five forces namely suppliers, buyers, substitutes, competitors and potential competitors that affect the competition situation of the environmental service industry. Finally some suggestions for China government and enterprises in the industry was proposed to provide theoretical guide in order to keep the sustainable development of the industry.

articleTitle: Detecting individual content-structure patterns in time series data
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: It is valuable to mine the spatio-temporal patterns from time series data set generated in real world applications. However, two problems of data point granularity determining and user behavior pattern describing are most challenging. To address these problems, in this work, we propose a time sequence based user behavior pattern describing method, in which, the time-related events are mapped on the time stream respectively. Then the user patterns are described according to two aspects, namely the content-based and the structure-based patterns. Based on these two aspects, a new method- CS Similarity, is proposed to measure the similarity of behavior pattern between two independent users'. The experimental results with the real transaction data of Guangzhou smart card show that the proposed method (CSM) has a better performance on finding the similarity pattern among people in compare with the classical methods of WM and SWM.

articleTitle: Comparison of international competitiveness on service trade between China and Germany
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The development level of services trade has become a key indicator to measure the trade strength of a country. In recent years, the development of services trade of Sino-Germany has a strong similarity. Therefore, this paper uses the display and analysis indexes to compare the international competitiveness of service trade between the two countries based on the service trade data of Sino-Germany from 2000 to 2010. It is concluded that the disparity of international competitiveness of service trade between China and Germany is mainly reflected in the gap of the modern service trade sector between the two countries. Specifically, the insurance and financial service is the largest-gap ones of the two countries, while ICT information communications and technology service is the smallest-gap ones. Finally it puts forward suggestions to improve the international competitiveness of China service trade based on the above conclusions.

articleTitle: Audit quality, audit fees and the CPA organizational forms
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In July 21, 2010, the Chinese MOF launched the Interim Provision on Encouraging Large and Medium-Sized CPA Firms to Adopt Limited Liability Partnership as their Organizational Structure (hereafter “Interim Provision”), which setting off a wave of accounting firms restructuring. We find that auditors in Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) are likely to undertake more legal liabilities and audit risks than General Partnership (GP) or Limited Liability Companies (LLC). Whether the strengthening of legal liability and audit risks will motivate firms to improve their audit quality and raise audit fees? In this study,we commence our sample with companies listed in the Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share main board markets from 2010 to 2013. Through correlation analysis and multiple regression analysis, empirical study shows that whether CPA firms have restructured or not it does not exist significant differences on audit quality and audit fees. Furthermore, CPA firms from the LLC to LLP didn't significantly raise audit quality and audit fees.

articleTitle: Research on the correlation between the SHIBOR and stock market returns based on the DCC-GARCH model
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Interbank Offered market (also called “Interbank Lending market”) and the stock market are important parts of China's financial market. This paper studies the relationship of Shanghai interbank offered rate (Interbank Offered Rate Shanghai, abbreviate “SHIBOR”) and stock market returns, which is benefit to grasp the change rules of them. It finds that the dynamic relationship between SHIBOR and stock market returns is timeliness and plate effect. Studying of the relationship between the rate of changes of SHIBOR and the returns of stock market can provide scientific basis for the steady development of the financial market.

articleTitle: The impact of P-O Fit and P-J Fit on work engagement-the moderating role of LMX
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Objective: To explore the influence of P-O fit and P-J fit on work engagement and the moderating role of leader-member exchange (LMX). Methods: Correlation and hierarchical regression were used to analyze the surveyed data collected from 214 employees through online questionnaires. Results: a. Control variables considered, P-O fit and P-J fit were positively and significantly correlated with work engagement; b. as LMX increased, the influence of P-J fit on work engagement increased; the influence of P-O fit on work engagement was not affected; c. as LMX increased, the influence of N-S fit on work engagement increased; the influence of D-A fit on work engagement was not affected. Conclusion: LMX moderated the relationship between P-J fit and work engagement and N-S fit and work engagement.

articleTitle: Research on the logistics management service socialization of public hospitals in Yunnan province
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The logistics management service system is the basis to operate a hospital, and is one of important indicators to evaluate the modernization level of a hospital. Owing to the powerful position of the public hospitals in China, their logistics management services are usually lagged behind, which affects the ability of sustainable development. In order to study the socialization progress of the logistics management service in Chinese public hospitals, the home and abroad logistics service socialization mode are summarized, the current situation and existing problems of logistics management service socialization in public hospitals in Yunnan province are analyzed, and the countermeasures and suggestions are put forward finally. It is expected to provide a theoretical reference for the improvement and promotion of logistics management service socialization practice in Yunnan province and China.

articleTitle: Social media user partitioning based on ensemble clustering
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In Web2.0 era, social media platforms are bearing huge customer base and excessively abundant information resources. On one hand, information consumers spend a lot of time in information search. On the other hand, information providers are seeking effective methods to recognize potential customers, push targeting advertising and provide personalized information services. Generally, mining user-generated content (UGC) to discover user preferences becomes the main channel for user modeling and customer partitioning. However, on social media platforms, user preferences were often manifested in the user-defined tags, online social behaviors as well as the UGC texts. The paper proposed a social-media user partitioning model based on heterogeneous information fusion and ensemble clustering. In the model, online social behaviors and user-defined interest tags are combined with UGC texts respectively to generate basic partitions of social media users. Then, basic partitions are fused into a consensus partition based on the voting mechanism for the final user partitioning. Experiments on real world data sets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Estimating TFP based on extended Solow residual value Method: A case study in Yunnan province
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Since the reforming and opening up of China, domestic and foreign scholars have made deep researches on the total factor productivity of China, but the different estimation results led to much controversy. Herein, the new method is used to estimate the two key indexes of capital and labor input in the paper. Based on that, by extended Solow residual value Method to undertake an empirical study on the total factor productivity of Yunnan province and its contribution to economic growth. Result shows that since 2003 the growth rate of total factor productivity of Yunnan province is -0.96. The contributive rate of economic growth is -8.60%. The contributive rate of material capital is 64.63%, which indicated the economic growth of Yunnan province is mainly driven by capital investment. The contribution of technological progress to economic growth is negative; the contribution rate of human capital is 6%, the contribution to economic growth remains low.

articleTitle: Effect of dispersion in beliefs on stock excess returns: Based on active mutual funds in China
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: We devote ourselves to research effect of dispersion in beliefs on stock excess returns about active mutual funds in China. We propose a measurement of dispersion in that what fund managers think about expected stock performance based on their active holdings, i.e., deviations from benchmarks. We draw the conclusion that both the level of and the change in dispersion positively predict subsequent stock returns on a risk-adjusted basis. This effect is particularly pronounced among stocks with high information asymmetry and binding short-sale constraints. These results suggest that a subgroup of informed managers drives up the dispersion in active holdings when they hold large bets once receiving relative private information. Binding short-sale constraints, however, prevents them from fully using their negative private information, leading to low dispersion in active holdings.

articleTitle: Manufacturer's optimal preselling discount rate with sufficient initial working capital
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper considers a supply chain consisting of one manufacturer and one retailer and models their interactions as a three-stage Stackelberg game with the incorporation of a preselling program, and derives the retailer's optimal advance ordering quantity and the manufacturer's optimal discount rate and production quantity. According to the analysis, it is shown that although he may own sufficient initial working capital, it is still possible for the manufacturer to provide a discount rate in the preselling stage in order to maximize his expected total profit.

articleTitle: Applied research of activity-based costing under ERP environment
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the continuous progress of science and technology and economic level, manufacturing enterprises' direct labor costs that account for the proportion of production costs continue to decline, the proportion of manufacturing costs rise sharply, The traditional cost accounting method is hard to reflect the true cost information. For “activity” as the center, based on the “cost drivers” imputation cost attract more attention. Introducing ideas on costing to ERP management platform, improving traditional cost accounting method, has become a hot research by many scholars. This paper studies the important role of the operating cost method for enterprises to improve cost management, the competitiveness aspects of the use of ERP environment, and on the basis of analysis of today's mainstream ERP systems costing application, noting ERP integration with costing and the importance of the theoretical basis, combined with cases to specifically illustrate how to apply costing.

articleTitle: Real-time identification and tracking of emission from vessels based on Automatic Identification System Data
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Real-time and automatic tracking emissions of vessels can help the maritime traffic department and environmental monitoring department to study quantitatively and provide foundation for setting pollution reduction measures, and defining policies for management departments. Traditionaly method is based on fuel consumptions of vessels which need the cooperation of vessel operators; it is hard to realised real-time computation of emission data. Among various sensors used for vessel identification, Automatic Identification System (AIS) have emerged as the state-of-the-art in recent years, providing much richer information than synthetic aperture radar. It has been applied in emission inventory of vessels for several years. This paper provides a review of the AIS-based emission inventory literature which includes empirical, experimental and analytical aspects. At last, we compared the AIS-based method and Fuel-based method and found that AIS-based method can provide more elaborate temporal and spatial emission distribution characteristics.

articleTitle: Service capacity planning of the community hospital under the hierarchical medical system
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: We combine with the present situation about the serious imbalance of medical resource utilization in Chinese referral system and study the service capacity design and the optimal referral rate determination of the community hospital under the hierarchical medical system. We establish an integrated model of the queuing and game theory, and analyze the equilibrium behavior of delay-sensitive patients. Class 3-A hospital fixed the service capacity and its service level is high enough. According to the total number of potential patients and class 3-A hospital's service capacity, government design the community hospital's service ability and determine the optimal referral rate from the perspective of the total social cost minimization. Under the condition of the patients' equilibrium behavior, the community hospital's optimal service capacity is a convex about the total potential patients and increases with the increasing of class 3-A hospital's service capacity; the total social cost is a convex about the service capacity of class 3-A hospital and increase with the increasing of the total number of potential patients. Thus, it is important to determine appropriate service capacity and service level of hospitals, and determine the appropriate treatment area of hospitals.

articleTitle: Export and productivity of enterprises: Based on the data of Chinese listed enterprises in manufacturing industry
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Based on the heterogeneous firm trade theory, we choose the data of Chinese listed enterprises in manufacturing industry from 2010 to 2014 to examine the relationship between export and the productivity of enterprises. In order to eliminate simultaneity and selectivity biases, we calculate the total factor productivity through Levinsohn-Petrin estimation. For the sake of robustness, we choose both labor productivity and total factor productivity as the representative of productivity respectively to examine the existence of self-selection effect and learning by exporting effect. The empirical results show that enterprises do not have self-selection effect but have learning by exporting effect. So they are with the regression results year by year. Thus, Chinese enterprises can improve their international competitiveness by export.

articleTitle: Correlations between the currency market & equity market based on B-N decomposition method
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The exchange rate and equity division reform enhance the integration of the currency market and equity market. B-N decomposition method is used in this paper to decompose the original data of RMB exchange rate and CSI 300 index. Then this paper studies the long-term volatility relationship between the two markets by analyzing the long-term transitory components decomposed in different stages. Results show that the equity market waves earlier than the currency market in the short period, and owns different causalities during different stages in the long period. The government should pay attention to the monitoring of two markets in case of risk spreading.

articleTitle: The documents reviewed of team performance appraisal methods
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This essay organizes and summarizes 21 essays and documents about team performance appraisal methods published on CSSCI core periodical, analysing and investigating from determination of nature, determination of quantity and the combination of both perspective. At the same time, the essay organizes and analyses the content of performance appraisal and the characteristics of subject evaluated, based on which suggestions on improvements can be put forward intended for investigator to make reference.

articleTitle: Truth-telling mechanisms for cooperative M/M/1 queueing systems
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper investigates truth-telling mechanisms for individual M/M/1 queueing systems to share their capacity. The cost we consider in this paper is congestion cost incurred by customers in the queueing system, wherein the unit congestion cost of each individual queueing system is private information. We first propose two Grove-Clarke mechanisms (truth-telling mechanisms) that satisfy budget balancedness and individual rationality, respectively. Then, we conduct numerical studies to evaluate performance of the proposed mechanisms. The results show that the proposed mechanism which satisfies individual rationality has very high percentage of budget coverage. This mechanism justifies the practice of requiring membership fees to join a cooperative alliance, and has good potential for practical applications.

articleTitle: Numerical valuation of options by DG method: A study of boundary condition formulation
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Option valuation is obviously the most efficient when done analytically. However, in many cases, including most types of exotic options no closed form of the pricing formula exists. In such cases, some numerical approximation is inevitable. In our recent research we focused on discontinuous Galerkin method to numerical solution of partial differential equations. Obviously, the flexibility in terms of model assumptions and/or additional conditions often brings high time costs so that it can be useful to reduce the space on which the computation is executed in order to keep both the computation time and calculation error at acceptable levels. In this paper we study the impact of various definitions of boundary condition, in particular the Dirichlet, Neumann and transparent one. Similarly to our previous results, we use real data of DAX index options to show the differences among various specifications.

articleTitle: The research about disseminating subway emergency information by BASS model
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: After the emergency in subways, disseminating the effective information is very important. In order to investigate diffused features of the subway emergency by different transmissions, this paper basses on the BASS model to build correct and incorrect models, and analyses the difference between these two models through the MATLAB. The result of analysis is that the rate of these two information curves is affected by channel coefficient. There is negative correlation between diffused scale and the distribution time of authoritative information. In order to gain more effective information of subway emergency, the subway managements should increase the range and speed of information dissemination, and should enhance passengers' knowledge of subway emergency.

articleTitle: Research on the correlation between onshore and offshore RMB markets
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Hong Kong as a center of renminbi offshore markets is developing rapidly in recent years, and the interaction between onshore and offshore markets has been more frequent. This paper selects Hong Kong as the representative of the RMB offshore markets to analyzes the general correlation between RMB onshore and offshore markets, and employed VAR model to understand the exchange rate correlation and found that, developments in the onshore spot market exert an influence on the offshore spot market. As a result of theoretical and empirical researches, put forward recommendations on expanding the positive effects of correlation to facilitate internationalization of RMB.

articleTitle: Impact of supply disruption on dynamic performance of a typical production inventory system
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern society, the external environment faced by enterprises is becoming increasingly uncertain. Among all uncertain factors, supply disruption has drawn much attentions from both the academic and industrial circles. This paper studies the dynamic performance of a typical production inventory system (automatic pipeline, inventory and order based production control system, APIOBPCS) in the presence of supply disruption. The impacts of the disruption start time and disruption duration on the APIOBPCS's dynamic performance indicators measured by different kinds of peak values are investigated. It is found that, as the disruption duration increases, each kind of peak increases if the disruption start time is relatively small, and keeps constant and increases sequentially if otherwise. Meanwhile, given any disruption duration, each kind of peak changes non-monotonically with the disruption start time.

articleTitle: Knowledge Network System Building and Realization
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: From the perspective of knowledge exchange and sharing, this paper researches on the Knowledge Network System Building and Realization. Firstly, it describes the whole framework of Knowledge Network System, builds the mode of Knowledge Network System flow according to current software technology. Secondly, this paper establishes the mode of Knowledge Network System function and introduces them respectively in allusion to the mode. Thirdly, it designs the structure of how to realize the Knowledge Network System, which is helpful in enterprise's knowledge management.

articleTitle: Research of video advertisements effect based on EEG: ERSP and emotion for commercial effect
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Many types of water TV commercials are presented to the consumer, and different commercials will bring diversity effect. Using traditional methods cannot get accurate results, so we adopt electroencephalogram (EEG) to analyses subjects' behavior. We choose four electrode channels in the frontal coral (FC) to map Event related spectral perturbations (ERSP) between 2 Hz and 15 Hz, then use the varying intensity and concentration of spectrum happened in the pre-and frontal coral (PFC) and FC to judge the subjects' emotion. Finally, ranking the memorization and attraction of different commercials according to the results of EEG experiments.

articleTitle: When to offer upgrades?
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: We consider a firm that sells multiple product models corresponding to multiple classes of demand. The firm may offer customers free upgrades to more expensive models when there is insufficient stock of the preferred models. However, customers may not accept upgrades due to their preference on the features of their desired models. Under this situation, it might be optimal to offer upgrades before stockout. We formulate the problem as a Markov decision process and prove that the optimal profit functions are anti-multimodular. Based on this property, we show the optimal upgrading policy can be described by a upgrade threshold policy. We also analyze the impacts the inventory levels on the upgrade thresholds. From the modeling point of view, our paper extends the model of Netessine (2002) to a more general and practical setting. We also show that under our settings, stockout substitution can lose significant profits. Finally, we extend our analysis to a model with dynamic pricing.

articleTitle: Optimal fee charge for VIP members under advertising and payment mixed business models of video sites
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Considering a monopolistic online video site through set the optimal pricing charge for the VIP members to max the total income. Through solving model, we found optimal VIP membership fees have a strong positive correlation not only with the added services value which is provide to the VIP members but also the degree of bother imposed by the advertising. What's more, the profit of advertising and the cost of provide added service to users both need to be paid by VIP members, but the basic value accepted by customers has no relationship with the optimal price charge for VIP members.

articleTitle: Cost-effective analyses on emergency medical services in Shanghai considering multiperiod ambulance redeployment
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Quick response to the emergency needs and rational arrangement of pre-hospital resources have always been the main concerns when developing emergency medical services (EMS). In recent years, redeployment is deemed as a new strategy to tackle this problem. In this paper, an EMS cost model is developed considering both delayed and redeployment cost. Time-dependent emergency needs are incorporated to the model. We apply our model to the data from Songjiang District, Shanghai and further analyze the cost-effectiveness of redeployment. The results show that the EMS system in Songjiang district can be greatly improved in terms of responsiveness and economical efficiency, but optimizing effect of redeployment in Songjiang case is limited.

articleTitle: Hierarchical user interest model based on large log data of mobile internet
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The development of mobile internet brings a new perspective for user interest model. Mobile logs record more behaviors which can build a more comprehensive model for personalized service or recommendation system. Comparing the VSM and semantic network, we choose Concept Hierarchy to model user interest considering hierarchical granularity relations and make the user interest vivid and clear. In the background of large scale data, we analyze the characteristic of mobile internet and propose a mechanism based on session, so as to make the process of modeling linear and superimposed. In addition, we employ unsupervised learning method to avoid storing large historic data. At the end, we import time decay function and spreading activation model to trace the change of user interest. Experiential results confirm the feasibility and availability.

articleTitle: Research on the optimal policies of supply chain with manufacturer-sponsored gift cards
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In recent years, with the intensification of market competition, more and more firms tend to use gift cards promotion. In this paper, based on the problem of retailer strategic inventory in two-period supply chain, we develop the model which with manufacturer-sponsored free gift cards promotion. We get the optimal wholesale price, retail price, the optimal inventory level that retailer should take at the end of first period and the results of optimal expected profit of the retailer and the manufacturer in two periods. Moreover, we do a comparative analysis between model NG and G, and find that the manufacturer's profit in model G is always better than the value in model NG. It means that manufacturer improve its profit though sponsoring free gift cards promotion.

articleTitle: The effect of status seeking on buyback contract coordination and its dynamics: Evidence from laboratory experiments
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper built extended buyback contract model, in which the preference of status seeking was added as part of utility function. Based on the extended model, the buyback contract failed to coordinate the supply chain and could not improve the whole efficiency. Furthermore, we find the dynamic process of status seeking preference. During the exchange period, individuals on the supply chain would like to maintain their leading status and increase the profit gap. It is concluded that the preference of status seeking would change individuals' equilibrium behavior, because they consider it as part of their goal. Unlike previous research, controlled experiments are designed to collect data. The empirical results support theory predictions.

articleTitle: The fairness when the retailers compete
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In this paper, we study a competing supply chain when retailers have fairness concerns. We solve the equilibrium solution under different range of fairness parameters. We show that when channel members are concerned about fairness, a simple wholesale price can coordinate the whole supply chain within certain range of fairness parameters. This research extends previous research by considering competition within the supply chain.

articleTitle: Earnings management through real activities manipulation by firms that publish short-term profit plans
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Accounting information published by a firm's manager is used for investment and debt contracts, which, in turn, affects subsequent funding and executive compensation. Thus, managers have an incentive to manipulate the profit, and they perform earnings management as a legitimate means. Managers also manipulate the profit toward the profit benchmark, which usually includes earnings forecasts and short-term profit plans. Earnings forecasts are based on managers' or analysts' expectations about the company's overall growth. Short-term profit plans are based on first-year, medium-term management. It appears that there is a relationship between these two aspects since they are generally announced simultaneously. The purpose of this study is twofold. First, it examines the relationship between short-term profit plans and first-quarter earnings forecasts. Second, it clarifies whether firm managers create short-term profit plans or first-quarter earnings forecasts by real activities manipulation. The findings show that in the firms that do not announce short-term profit plans, they conduct earnings forecasts through real activities manipulation. Conversely, in the firms that announce short-term profit plans, the managers do not conduct real activities manipulation. For the reasons stated above, in firms that do not announce short-term profit plans, managers might establish internal short-term profit plans that differ from external earnings forecasts.

articleTitle: Impact of clinical information quality on healthcare diagnosis quality: An empirical study
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: As information technology (IT) plays an increasingly important role in healthcare services, the impact of information quality on healthcare diagnosis quality has been gradually concerned by the healthcare industry. We choose the Pelvic Trauma Surgery of a hospital as the object of this study, and establish a model for healthcare diagnostic processes. After we use accuracy as the quantitative measurement of clinical information quality, diagnostician quality and healthcare diagnosis quality, the functional relationship between clinical information quality and diagnosis quality of pelvic fractures is derived. The results of this study show that along with the growth of clinical information quality, diagnosis quality of pelvic fractures improves slowly until it reaches the summit. Besides, diagnosis quality of pelvic fracture type A of this hospital is much higher than that of other two types.

articleTitle: A study on the effect of the Semi-mandatory Dividend Policy on the capital market
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: To enhance the listed firms' willingness to pay out cash dividend and to improve the level of ratio of cash dividend to net profit, the China Securities Regulatory Commission has enacted six files about cash dividend policy of listed firms from2001 to 2013, which are defined “Semi-mandatory Dividend Policy” by academia.. The policy does not stipulate the specific ratio of cash dividend to net profit but relates the level of cash dividend policy to listed firms' refinancing qualification, which has triggered controversy during its implementation. The empirical analysis selects the firms listed on the Shanghai or Shenzhen stock exchange before 2012 as samples. The analyzing year interval varies from 2001 to 2014. For building panel data model, design the willingness of paying cash dividend and the ratio of cash dividend to net profit separately as the dependent variable and the policy variable divided by year as the main independent variables with listed firms' characteristics and the industry characteristics as controlling variables.

articleTitle: The influence of QFII shareholdings on excess stock returns
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Since the introduction of QFII scheme in Chinese security market in 2003, the number of approved institutions and the approved investment quota have grown quickly. QFII have already become the second important institutional investors in the A-share market after the fund. This paper selects the data of QFII shareholdings and stock returns from March 2008 to December 2014. We establish multiple linear regression model and use the Fama-French Three-Factor Model to measure the excess stock returns, in order to analyze the influence of QFII shareholding behavior on excess stock returns. The empirical results show that: on the one hand, the more the number of QFII holding the stock, the lower the excess returns, while the effect is small. On the other hand, the higher the market value of QFII shareholdings, the higher the excess returns, but the effect is not very significant.

articleTitle: Research on the benign interaction between onshore financial openness and offshore RMB market development
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The research on the causal relationship between onshore financial openness and offshore Renminbi markets development is not only an attempt to the research gap, but also practically significant to the internationalization of Renminbi. Based on the previous literature, this thesis firstly analyzes the interaction mechanisms from the theoretical level. Then, econometric empirical analysis is used for the research on the mutual effects of the onshore financial Openness and the development level of offshore Renminbi market. Finally, corresponding suggestions are proposed.

articleTitle: Quality design and shelf investment in different distribution channels
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper investigates product quality design and shelf investment decision for a manufacturer considering that consumers' perception of product quality can be affected by shelf display in retailing industry. We discuss production quality decision and shelf display investment in decentralized and centralized channel with heterogenous consumers. In decentralized supply chain, the manufacturer first decides his marketing mix, i.e., product quality level and wholesale price, the retailer then determines her shelf display investment and retail price. The subgame perfect Nash equilibrium of the manufacturer- Stackelberg game shows that, comparing with centralized channel, the manufacturer will improve his product quality and the retailer will invest more in shelf display in decentralized channel. The price is also higher than that in centralized channel. In addition, the first-move advantage is achieved in decentralized channel.

articleTitle: Creative leader behaviors in R&D teams: Antecedents and consequences
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This study explore creative leader behavior in R&D teams based on the leadership theory and then put forward a two-factor structure, including task-oriented behavior and management-oriented behavior. In study1, the scale of creative leader behavior is developed using three independent samples. Confirmatory factor analyses support the two dimensions of creative leader behavior measurement. In study 2, the antecedents and consequences are examined with another sample of 244 pairs of leader-member questionnaires. Results show that leader's emotional intelligence and expectation for creativity are positively related to creative leader behavior, which is associated with employee creativity and intrinsic motivation in turn.

articleTitle: Spammer detection based on comprehensive features in Sina Microblog
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The popularity and accessibility of Sina Microblog have attracted a large number of spammers to conduct spamming behaviors. They can spread advertisements, disseminate pornography, virus and expose phishing. All of these behaviors are extremely harmful to legitimate users. It is necessary to detect spammers from legitimate users in Sina Microblog. In this paper, we defined two kinds of spammers, advertising spammers and following spammers. We extracted six features to distinguish advertising spammers, following spammers and legitimate users. To verify the effectiveness of our method, we use four kind machine learning algorithms, including Bayes Network, Naive Bayes, SVM and Random Forest to evaluate the spammer detection performance on our dataset. The results of these experiments show that most of the classifiers can achieve more than 90% precision rate, recall rate and F-measure rate. Bayes Network classifier was proved to the best on our dataset.

articleTitle: Supply-side comparison and inspiration between Chinese and Indian higher education
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Through PEST analys method, it discusses the environmental opportunity and challenges faced in the development process of higher education in China and India, then compares the contradiction between the quality and quantity of higher education in China and India. The supply side of higher education is difficult to adapt to the rapid change of domestic demand. It highlights the difference of institutional supply. At last it proposes that only deepening reform, guarantee quality, increase the investment, learning from each other and thus promoting total factor productivity can avoid the “middleincome trap”.

articleTitle: The relationship between corporate governance and bank loan financing capacity: Evidence from companies listed on China's GEM
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In this paper, taking companies listed on China's GEM (Growth Enterprises Market) as samples from 2012 to 2014, we test the role of corporate governance in bank credit decision. By examining the influence of corporate governance on bank loan financing capacity, we found that corporate governance factors have no impact on the bank loan financing capacity, banks pay more attention to the financial performance and operating capability. Our results illustrate that the corporate governance factors have a limited role in bank credit decision.

articleTitle: Audit quality and its affecting factors: A literature review from the perspective of accounting firms
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In this article, we review the literatures published on international journals and most of them are published in recent years. In the first part, we make an introduction about this literature review. And then, we summarize the definition of audit quality. In addition, we quote and summarize other researchers' studies, which explore the factors that affect the audit quality. Finally, we draw conclusion and recommend for the future research direction.

articleTitle: The case study on the supplier certification system of B2C platform enterprise
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Taking a B2C platform enterprise as an example, combining with the characteristics of B2C platform enterprise and its suppliers, this study classifies suppliers, analyzes and optimizes supplier qualification process within B2C platform enterprise. In terms of different types of suppliers, this study establishes a supplier certification index system for B2C platform enterprise from two stages, including the early access certification and late assessment certification. Finally, the study establishes an evaluation model with the combination of analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method (FCE). A questionnaire survey will be divided to obtain data and perform the demonstration of calculation, through which the effectiveness of the accreditation standards and evaluation methods are verified.

articleTitle: Research on recovery model of the fourth party logistics considering government subsidy
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The paper integrates fourth party logistics (4PL) into reverse logistics, analyzing decision-making problem of manufacturers, retailers, 4PL enterprises and government by the game theory, and discussing the relationship of 4PL enterprise investments and recovery amounts, the rate of government subsidies and investments, environmental benefits and government subsidies. The results shows: the scale of 4PL enterprises recovery can be achieved through 4PL enterprises investment; the government subsidy can not only reduce the threshold of 4PL enterprises entering the recycling industry to promote 4PL development in reverse logistics, but also realize the maximum of environmental benefits.

articleTitle: The influence of service trade structure on economic growth in China
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The service trade has become more and more important, while the material life level has reached a certain level. Overall, the development of service trade is bound to contribute to economic development. However, the role of particular service sectors will vary. This paper is based on the data from 1998 to 2014. With the initial trend analysis, reclassifying 12 departments based on fund capital intensive, human capital intensive and knowledge capital intensive, this paper studied the influence of service trade structure on economic growth in China, by the vector autoregression model (VAR).

articleTitle: Research on the optimization of allocating resources of urban taxi based on decision analysis model
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Taxi is one of the important transportation for citizens to travel. It is a hot issue of society which attracts people's attention, because it is hard to take a taxi. According to series of problems of hailing taxis and combining present subsidy schemes of various taxi companies in the era of `Internet Plus', we select optimum scheme by using Analytic Hierarchy Process Model and evaluate the extent of the impact of each scheme on solving the problem by using Decision Analysis Model. Finally, we find the optimum taxi subsidy scheme to work out the problem.

articleTitle: Key industries selection of business and trade service in Tongzhou district
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In this paper, we selected the key industries of Tongzhou BTS through four different models, they are income elasticity model, productivity efficent model, BCG model, and grey relative degree model, then we synthesize the four results with weighted mean. The result shows that the priorities of Tongzhou BTS industries are: financial; rental and business service; real estate; resident service and other service; information transmission, computer services and software services; transportation, storage and postal service; accommodation and catering; culture, sports and entertainment; wholesale and retail. Finally, we give some strategy advice on the development of key industries.

articleTitle: The literature review of book-tax difference
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper reviews relevant literature that sheds light on the issue surrounding book-tax difference (BTD). The paper includes four main parts of the literature: (1) the trade-off between financial income and taxable income; (2) the measurements of BTD; (3) the economic consequences of BTD, and (4) conclusion. In addition, We provide opinions regarding the interesting and important issues for future research.

articleTitle: A newsvendor problem with two suppliers under dual-channel supply chain and supply disruption
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In this paper, we consider a newsvendor model in which the retailer can source from two suppliers. One supplier sells products through a dual channel framework, which includes a direct channel and a retailer channel. The other supplier sells products only through the retailer. The wholesale price of the dual channel supplier is cheaper, but supply disruption may occur with a certain probability, whereas the other supplier is perfectly reliable with a higher wholesale price. We study a risk-neutral retailer's decision-making on the optimal order quantities from both two suppliers. Then in numerical analysis, we examine the sensitivity of the disruption probability, the wholesale price, market shares of two channels and the direct price on the optimal decisions.

articleTitle: Multi-case study on business model of reverse supply chain in electronics industry under Extended Producer Responsibility
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: E-waste has become one of the focuses of social concern and research topic, not only for its tremendous amount, but also for its negative environment influence. Under Extended Producer Responsibility, the manufacturer plays an important role in the reverse supply chain which it participates in. And the implementation effects of business models of these reverse supply chains are various. By the method of multi-case study, this paper focuses on business model of reverse supply chain in electronics industry. Five business cases on EPR practices implemented by electronics manufacturers within their reverse supply chains are identified and analyzed in this research. Several types of representative business models are identified, and the advantages and disadvantages of these business models are also explored. Focusing on the electronics industry, this research aims to provide operation suggestions on the business model of reverse supply chain for the construction and management of reverse supply chain under EPR.

articleTitle: Asymmetric carbon information in a dual-channel supply chain
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper investigates the misreporting behaviors of the dual channel supply chain members and their influences on supply chain performance. The results show that there exist equilibrium solutions when manufacturer have the information priority. More importantly, considered about the dual channel of sales, we find the higher market share of the retail channel would encourage manufacturer to exaggerate his carbon emission information. And the higher market share of the retail channel would encourage retailer to understate his carbon emission information.

articleTitle: Managing product variety on platform: Product market risk and scope economies
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: While millions of products are available on online retailing platforms, We investigate how a platform owner, facing product market risk and scope economies, may identify which products are worthwhile for itself selling (called reselling mode, purchasing products from manufacturers and selling them to consumers) and which ones are the best left for platform selling (on which manufacturers selling their products directly to consumers). Weather the reselling mode or platform mode is preferred depending on the magnitude of scope economies and product market risk. We show that the platform owner itself stocks and sells when the degree of scope economies is strong and the product market risk is low.

articleTitle: A Service quality evaluation system of third party logistics by college students under the Chinese E-commerce environment
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Chinese e-commerce has developed rapidly in the recent years, making the scale of the third party logistics (3PL) business constantly larger and the competition fiercer. Hence, ensuring service quality of logistics and improving satisfaction of logistics service have been the keys to survive for 3PL enterprises. Meanwhile, college students have been important members in the online shopping industry, while their needs for logistics service differ with other customer groups. Consequently, 3PL enterprises should find out the need of college students and constantly improve their logistics service to achieve success in competition. The paper presents a service quality evaluation system of 3PL enterprises by college students under the Chinese e-commerce environment, based on SERVQUAL model. An empirical analysis of STO Express, a leader of Chinese 3PL enterprises, is conducted then to test the service quality of logistics and excavate the main driving factors to improve service for STO Express.

articleTitle: The research on environmental accounting information disclosure of Chinese listed companies in the steel industry
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Under the background of the rapid development of China's market economy, circular economy and green economy has become the theme of the times. Due to the high energy consumption and pollution of the steel industry, the environmental accounting information disclosure is particularly necessary. The article selects the 36 steel listed companies in China as research samples, using statistical analysis method, reveals its present situation of environmental information disclosure. In view of the existing problems, some suggestions are put forward to improve the environmental accounting information disclosure in the steel industry.

articleTitle: Game theory analysis of P2P regulation
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: As the Chinese on-line private lending size expands and its influence on financial system deepens, how to regulate it has become a vital issue of financial regulatory department. In this paper, we constructed the game model among investors, p2p lending platforms and the government, and analyzed equilibrium path of platforms choice under private lending registration system. We concluded that the means of reducing tax, reducing information asymmetry and government rent-seeking, and increasing penalty of law violation can accelerate the exposure of p2p lending platforms, and also proposed several suggestions from the perspective of information asymmetry.

articleTitle: The research of factors influence doctor-patient relationship quality: Investigation of public hospitals in Sichuan province
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to reveal the factors influence doctor-patient relationship quality and put forward several suggestions accordingly. This study took 166 managers and medical staffs from public hospital in Sichuan province as investigation object, using questionnaire survey and content analysis, and summing up four main factors affecting doctor-patient relationship quality, including: hospital , patient, medical system and society. The influencing factors from hospital are referred most, and the process quality plays a more important role than that of the result quality and medical expenses. And suggestions mainly include the medical system reform, service quality improvement, patient two-way communication and guiding the media to report from objective point.

articleTitle: An agri-food supply chain traceability system for China based on RFID & blockchain technology
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: For the past few years, food safety has become an outstanding problem in China. Since traditional agri-food logistics pattern can not match the demands of the market anymore, building an agri-food supply chain traceability system is becoming more and more urgent. In this paper, we study the utilization and development situation of RFID (Radio-Frequency IDentification) and blockchain technology first, and then we analyze the advantages and disadvantages of using RFID and blockchain technology in building the agri-food supply chain traceability system; finally, we demonstrate the building process of this system. It can realize the traceability with trusted information in the entire agri-food supply chain, which would effectively guarantee the food safety, by gathering, transferring and sharing the authentic data of agri-food in production, processing, warehousing, distribution and selling links.

articleTitle: A hybrid method for multi-class sentiment analysis of micro-blogs
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the development of social media, huge volumes of micro-blogs convey not only the factual information, but also the emotional status of individuals, which are crucial for understanding user behaviors in those micro-blogging systems. However, a micro-blog is typically very short and may contain rich sentiments other than the positive and negative, like the anxious, which brings great challenges to the so-called multi-class sentiment analysis. Although the model-based and lexicon-based methods are the two primary approaches extensively investigated and regularly used in this field, it is argued by some researchers that the model-based method provides poor results in multi-class analysis while the lexicon-based method is difficult to reflect the characteristics of short texts. In this paper, we propose a hybrid method for multi-class sentiment analysis of micro-blogs, which combines the model-based approach with the lexicon-based approach. Considering the effect of emoticons, we use emoticons and Naïve-Bayes classification to divide micro-blogs into three sentiments—positive, negative and neutral. After that, we use sentiment dictionaries to identify four negative sentiments—angry, sad, disgusted and anxious. We evaluate our algorithm on a real-life micro-blogging dataset collected from the popular Chinese micro-blogging site, Sina, and the results show that it is effective and efficient for timely sentiment analysis. Our method has been further applied to a Weibo User Profiling System and enabled the sentiment analysis of real-time micro-blogs.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the features influencing users' adoption towards personal health records system
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Personal health records system (PHRs) is an increasingly popular area in medical activities. It is conceded that PHRs could improve healthcare documentation, increase information access for patients and providers and help patients to better control the expenses of care. Consumers who use PHR could gain more knowledge about their health conditions, inquire more questions, and feel more connected to their physicians and make moves to improve their health. Although PHRs have various potential benefits to patients, hospitals as well as institutions, the supporting evidence of specific benefits and successfully business cases for PHR adoption is limited and wide use and adoption of PHRs has not appear. To promote the adoption of PHR system, understanding the factors that affect patients' adoption of PHR system is of necessity. However, little research has been done to learn what prospective users want in a PHR. The characteristic of PHR system and consumers both play a pivotal role in influencing the PHR adoption decision. This paper was to use PHR features to explain the relationships. Seven independent variables including relative advantage, compatibility, complexity, data quality, data model quality, privacy and interactivity was adopted, exerting significant positive or negative influence on the factors including perceived usefulness and trust. And the variables of PU and trust were assumed positively related with individuals' willingness to adopt PHR system. The SPSS and partial least squares (PLS) technique was adopted to examine the casual relationships this paper hypothesized. Therefore, suggestion regarding what developers, institutions and government should do to improve the adoption rate of PHR was raised.

articleTitle: Wisdom of fusion: Prediction of 2016 Taiwan election with heterogeneous big data
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Using social media for political discourse has received much attention due to its real-time and interactive nature, especially around election time. Recent studies have explored the power of a single social media platform, such as Google or twitter, on recording current social trends and predicting the voting outcomes in a particular region. These pilot studies, though being very interesting, fail to integrate more of the heterogeneous information available online, nor do they consider the demographical bias of online users most of whom are young people. In this work, by aggregating online data from social media and offline data from pollsters, we achieve accurate prediction of candidates' votes in 2016 Taiwan presidential election, with error rates ranging from 0.30% to 2.85%. Our main contributions are summarized as follows. First, to our best knowledge, we are among the earliest studies to fuse heterogeneous information for election prediction. Three types of online information as signals of online public opinion are obtained from social networking sites (e.g. Facebook and Twitter), search engines (e.g. Google), and campaign homepages. To avoid voter bias, we further introduce offline demographical information to weight online and offline voting for a final prediction. Second, by taking election prediction as an unsupervised sequential prediction task, we introduce Kalman filter, a widely used signal processing method, to automatically select reliable information sources and fuse them for daily prediction. Finally, by taking into account the sensitivity of tweet volumes on Twitter, the Moving Average model is applied for real-time burst detection. Our work provides unique values to identifying important online information sources as well as their valid periods for election prediction, and shows great potentials for event influence analytics.

articleTitle: A quality and safety control system for China's dairy supply chain based on HACCP & GS1
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In recent years, food safety accidents have frequently happened in China's dairy industry, which makes people have already lost their confidence in China's dairy market. Therefore, building a set of quality and safety control system to ensure the quality and safety of dairy products has become more and more urgent. As a systematic preventive method for food safety, HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points) has been widely used in each link of the food supply chain. It could analyze and control safety hazards at every key point of the food supply chain. However, the information of these points in the different parts of the supply chain is isolated. In this paper, we propose a quality and safety control system of the dairy supply chain based on the combination of HACCP and GS1 (Global Standard 1). By using GS1, this system could connect all the HACCP points along the dairy supply chain, and implement information collecting, transferring, storing, checking, and sharing among the supply chain members, which could effectively improve the supply chain efficiency, and guarantee the quality and safety of dairy products.

articleTitle: Customer satisfaction and customer loyalty towards the Green Hotel: Based on cases studied in Ken-ding area in Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to discuss the customer satisfaction and customer loyalty towards the Green Hotel, and through the depth interviews with the local Green Hotel traders in Ken-ding area, knowing what the local traders can do to promote the customer satisfaction and customer loyalty to drive the customers participating in the project of environmental protection actively. From the research, it's obviously to know that the local traders think the government should do more efforts to advertise and educate customers about the concept of environmental protection in order to lead them take the initiative in caring and loving the natural environment. Although most of the customers have certain cognition of the idea environmental protection, they still lack a clear concept about it. Owning to this defect, a lot of customers are unable to fulfill the idea of protecting the environment. Basically, people choose to stay at hotels to get comfortable and convenient living surroundings that hotels can offer, and that's the different concept from what the local Green Hotel traders think about “implementing” the idea about environmental protection. The local Green Hotel traders can only put signs in their hotels to remind the customers to know the difference between staying at hotels and Green Hotels, hoping to reduce the frequency of the customers' complaint. Besides, the research also shows that either the hotel owners or the guest-house owners in Ken-ding area always try their best to do a good job in the field of environmental protection, and on the premise that the customers' rights will be highly taken care of, local traders have done everything they can to make customers satisfied with their service. In addition, the local traders use the opportunity to educate their customers, help them realize the trend and benefit of “Green Consumption.” So, in order to achieve the goal of good performance of environmental management, the Green Hotel needs traders, employees, and customers to participate and cooperate together. By doing so, the Green Hotels can not only have higher customer loyalty but can also get better result about marketing environmental protection through their customers' word of mouth to their friends and relatives to achieve their goal of environmental protection.

articleTitle: Innovation investment and revenue sharing in collaborative New Product Development
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Motivated by industrial cases, this paper investigates cross-function New Product Development (NPD) alliances evolving a market development firm and a technology development firm. Firms face market uncertainty or technology uncertainty during the NPD process. They determine collaboration agreements by negotiation and are rewarded by sharing total revenues after successful development. Two collaboration mechanisms, differentiated by firms sharing innovation investment or not, are analyzed and compared. This research emphasizes the effects of uncertainty type and launch costs on partner firms' strategic decisions in collaborative NPD. It is found that the preferred collaboration mechanism always go beyond pure revenue sharing to share innovation investment. These sharing parameters change significantly along the uncertainty types. Firms are expected to gain unequal profits even they have the same bargaining powers in negotiation.

articleTitle: Exploring consumers' use behavior on internet finance in China: From the perspective of the financial products similar to Yu'e Bao
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore the key factors affecting consumer's use behavior on financial products similar to Yu'e Bao. Considering the financial market and policy environment in China, theoretical model is founded based on extending Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) and the hypotheses are put forward. Then, to test the model and hypotheses, 199 valid data is collected by online survey and analyzed with the help of software SPSS 19.0 and AMOS 17.0. The results show that performance expectancy, social influence, trust, government e-readiness and facilitating conditions have positive effects on user's usage intention towards financial products similar to Yu'e Bao. Then the corresponding countermeasures and advices are put forward. The findings will not only help Chinese internet financial companies to improve their service, but also provide specific directions to regularize the industry of internet finance in China.

articleTitle: A hybrid discrete differential evolution algorithm for dynamic scheduling in robotic cells
publicationTitle: 2016 13th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
